lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: That's different from what you told Nayuta.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: About Marian.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: You told Nayuta she's the next Queen, but to Chatterbox, you said she's only the next vessel for the Queen.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: So, which is it?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Well, of course...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: what I told Nayuta.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: So you tricked Chatterbox?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Yes, there's no reason not to.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Poor Chatterbox is desperately seeking the Queen's approval.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Believing he has already been recognized and saved by her, he will do anything for her...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: He's burning with a sense of purpose, however hopelessly misguided it may be.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: The Queen would never acknowledge Chatterbox.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: So you lied to him?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Yes, I lied and told him the Queen said so.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: He really fell for it easily.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Since Chatterbox isn't a Heretic, he can't hear the Queen's voice anyway. So it was really easy.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: From my perspective, the more protectors Marian has, the better.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: He didn't seem to understand what being a protector means, so I had to remind him, but it should be fine now.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: And besides, Chatterbox has ties with the Heretics, so he brings me all sorts of information.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Such a pitiful little creature, so very easy to manipulate.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: And if he goes telling the other Heretics... what then?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: He won't. He thinks doing so might cost him the Queen's recognition.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hehe, he really is something. I hope the next Queen turns out like that too.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Oh, there was one time he was a bit of a headache.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Nihilister once ordered Chatterbox to find Vapaus,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: and I had to rack my brain to find a way to clean that up.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Other than that, there's no puppet quite like him.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: I'm realizing all over again what a nasty piece of work you are.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I, too, would do anything to win.
Trombe, Mantra, and T.A.L.O.S. run side by side.
The surviving Nayuta clones had their eyes fixed on that sight.
One lifts a hand in farewell. Another lowers her head in a solemn bow. A third clasps her hands in silent prayer.
Though their voices don't reach them, their meaning is clear.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Our charge is clear:

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: to vanquish the Maiden of Thunder.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Verily, Young Lady Harran's strike hath surely left her frame marred beyond measure.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Yet our foe is a Heretic, whose gift of regeneration must not be scorned.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Ere she be made whole anew, we must needs bring her down.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Thus shall the Forerunner maidens contend with one hindrance fewer in their strife.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Um, what should we do about Chatterbox?

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: You need not trouble thyself over the Loquacious One.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: ... He is naught but a mere pawn, subject to the whims of more puissant hands.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: He shall pose no threat. Verily, he mayhap hath already met his demise.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: I strongly agree. The special entity Chatterbox is not strong.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Well... that's two wins out of two. Yeah, that's right.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: And if push comes to shove...

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text:
I will no longer connect our cores. 
The risk is too great.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: I'll only use it if I have to... if I really have to.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Art thou nervous, Young Lady Chime?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: 'Tis not so!

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Pray, why art thou so silent?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Speak not to me!
Nayuta closes her mouth and gazes silently at Chime's profile.
At first glance, she seems tense, but her expression is clearly...

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Haha. Serves you right.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Shut up...!

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: You can't even transform?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Huh... looks like I might actually be able to beat you.
Indivilia's tail lashes out,
leaving a long gash across Nihilister's cheek.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Ah, my apologies. My body isn't quite cooperative, so my control is off.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Did you see my tail just now? No?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Then I suggest you stop uttering such nonsense.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: So just give me an arm already.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: I'll regenerate and help you out.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Right now, I'm practically a walking corpse. Even if I wanted to help, I couldn't.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: I'd love to obey our Great Mother like a loyal mutt,

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: just like you.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... You're best suited to remain a fool who can do nothing in this fight.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: And that's exactly what you'll continue to be.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Haha, you actually think you've got what it takes

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: to take them on?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: What is there to fear? The Queen is with us.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Well, I'll be... such control.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: To think someone who ran wild like you would follow orders so well.
Indivilia snaps her head around, irritation flaring.
A swirling cloud of dust is approaching.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... Human imposters.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Let's see.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: ... Haha.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: A little brat, a hunk of scrap, and a damn monk?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Hey, looks like they're here for you.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: And you know what that means, right?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Those nobodies actually think they can take you down!

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: What the hell have you been up to that even those losers are coming after you?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Hahaha! You're seriously pathetic, you know that?
Indivilia's tail lashes out,
the blade at its tip stopping a breath away from Nihilister's neck.
Unfazed, Nihilister runs her fingers along the blade.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Great Mother said no fighting, remember?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Hey, they're coming.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Better get ready to die.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: I'll even say a prayer for you, heh.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... Very well.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: How fortuitous.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I have been in need of a vessel for my ire.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Behold, the Maiden of Thunder and Fire Dragon standeth before us.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I shall go first.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Huh? Ch-Chime! What are you gonna do all by yourself...?!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Hie thee, Trombe!
Trombe gallops ahead with Chime on its back.
In an instant, it puts distance between itself and T.A.L.O.S. and Mantra.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Chime! Wait! What kind of reckless stunt is this...?!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Thou villain! Indivilia!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: How darest thou! How darest thou wound Her Highness's sacred body?!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: That grievous crime... e'en a hundred deaths shall not atone for it!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I shall take thy head, mark my words,

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: though it be the last thing I do!

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Chime, you've got to calm down, or—

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Come to think of it, I owe you one.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Allow me to exact my due.
The distance between Indivilia and Chime narrows.
Chime, still astride Trombe, suddenly leaps forward as if throwing herself.
Indivilia smiles, as though she had expected it all along, confident in her victory.
Aye, keep smiling so.
Thou'lt surely aim for my throat.
That is thy way, after all.
As I struck at thine, so shalt thou strike at mine.
I have no skill to dodge thy blow,
yet I trust it shall come to pass.
Chime flips through the air.
Indivilia's blade passes through where her neck had been.
Instead, her back takes the blow, but it isn't deep.
Chime's spin comes to a halt, and her eyes lock with Indivilia's.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Now, 'tis my only chance.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Indivilia...!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: The glorious power Her Highness hast granted me...!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I shall pour it all upon thee...!
Alva Particle Conversion-Type Expansive Armament.
Naked King, activate.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: This...!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: A prize the king has bestoweth upon me!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Take it gloriouslyyyyy!
Clad in radiant royal robes, Chime swings her fist.
The impact triggers a massive shockwave that crashes into Indivilia.
Overwhelmed by a pain she knows all too well, she drops to the ground.
Moments later, Chime plummets, her body hitting the ground like a falling meteor.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: T.A.L.O.S.! Finish her!

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Roger. I will blow her all the way into space.
T.A.L.O.S. charges in, grabs Indivilia by the tail, and hurls her into the air with all its might.
Indivilia plummets, completely out of control.
Meanwhile, Nayuta positions herself at the spot where she expects Indivilia to fall.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Howbeit mine outward seeming, this humble one is full well versed in the noble art of self-defense... soothly!
Nayuta swings her arms in a circle.
The falling Indivilia begins to spin as if being pulled into it.
Her head crashes into the ground at terrifying speed.
A massive shockwave ripples outward, accompanied by a deafening boom.
The impact on her weakened body leaves Indivilia's mind swimming in haze.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: ... Chime!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Uh... Ugghh...!
T.A.L.O.S. drapes a camouflage tarp over Chime, who lies bare on the ground.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: My... whole body... aches...

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Her Highness is most wondrous... I cannot fathom how she doth wield this with such ease...

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: You're incredible too, Chime! I didn't think you could actually use the Naked King...!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Ha... ha. As the kingdom's foremost vassal... 'tis but... natural.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Ah... urgh...!

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: ... Thou art still conscious? How impressive.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Nihi... lister...!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Fi... ght...!

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: What the hell do you want me to do?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: You... useless...!

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Heh, you're the one who made me this way.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Nihi... lister is really weak right now, right?

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: If she's even a little recovered, there's no way we could handle her on our own...!

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: ... Damn it.
Nihilister takes a step forward.
She clenches and unclenches her fist, shakes out her legs, and rolls her neck with a sharp crack.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: I-it seems like she actually wants to fight?

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: The detected output is low. However, it is unknown whether she possesses any hidden abilities.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: ... Hey, damn Monk.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Yes, Fire Dragon. Speak thy mind.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: I have to fight you.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: I know I don't stand a chance, that it'll just be a meaningless death to stall for time.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: But I have to fight.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: It's an order—

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: a damn order I can't refuse.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Ha! The oh-so Great Mother commands me to fight to the death.
Nihilister kicks the fallen Indivilia.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Hey, that's just how it is for us.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: This is the way we live, and the way we die. Got it?
Nihilister takes another step forward.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Fire Dragon.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: How long wilt thou continue living thus?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: What of it?

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Let us desist.

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Verily, 'tis somewhat mortifying to behold.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: ... Is that so?

lines.speaker: nayuta_m
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: What else can I do? I was born this way.
Nayuta silently points at Indivilia
and nods her head.
Nihilister's gaze falters.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: What... are you doing...?!
Indivilia staggers to her feet.
Kilo and T.A.L.O.S. immediately assume combat stances.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Who told you to... chat the day away...?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I said fight...! Fight! I command you to fight!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: If you can't manage that... at least be a meat shield...

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: so I can escape...!
Nihilister stares intently at Indivilia, who is trembling in front of her.
Wait...
hold on a sec. You actually ate me before, didn't you?
I went all out to save you, even handed over my weapons,
and this is how you repay me?! Betrayed by you, of all people!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Nihilister...! Can you not hear me?!
The hell's your problem?
Getting mad at me
and ordering me around?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: You useless corpse...! Do something!
Argh...
This is pissing me off!
Something snaps
inside Nihilister's head.
*Snap!*
Nihilister's sharp teeth
sink into Indivilia's neck.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Hey,

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: you'll make a fine snack.
